'''Denarii Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|base]] of laboratories and habitation modules in the [[Denarii Nebula/Legends|Denarii Nebula]]&mdash;the [[Gas/Legends|gaseous]], highly ionized remnant of the [[Denarii system]], a [[Binary star system/Legends|double-star]] [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was [[Battle at the Denarii Nova|destroyed]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] of [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]<ref name="TFOTSE">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 5]]</ref>&mdash;in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was originally used by [[Astrophysicist/Legends|astrophysicists]] for studying the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], but it fell into disuse [[Standard year/Legends|centuries]] before [[43 ABY]]. Nevertheless, the station was still used as a hideout by the desperate.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Denarii Station and its parent system first appeared in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], on the map depicting the Gordian Reach sector. The station also received a brief description in the list accompanying the map, which described the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the Gordian Reach. ''The Essential Atlas'' gave the station the grid square coordinates of P-6.<ref name="TEA" />
